gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase around them, with curves that stay open to the outside. And Amatic SC scribbles above it in one thin, quirky line, so give the plain sans body a little more size than you'd expect.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC draws chalky curves that stop well short of closing, with ascenders barely rising above the x-height, all in a modern, quiet voice. Amatic SC is the rustic hand-lettered one; this body is the steady worker.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Hand-scrawled and slightly wild, Amatic SC traces a constant-width outline you could follow with a fingertip. But Noto Sans Sharada underneath is bulky in its lowercase, with open c forms that never close into rings.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Approachable and a bit cheeky, Amatic SC runs as a single monoline stroke with terminals stopping far from the stem. Save it for big, short headings, while Noto Sans Siddham brings a large central band in the text line and an s with ends hanging well away from its spine.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Amatic SC looks like toothpaste squeezed out in one line, with no extra weight on its downstrokes at all. Noto Sans Sinhala then lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase beneath it, curve endings staying well apart.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo has a sizable x-height and wide, unclosed curves. Shrink Amatic SC down and its pen-and-paper charm thins out, since no calligraphic swelling anywhere in the outlines gives it extra body.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese reads tidy and compact, with open-mouthed e crossbars and almost no gap between x-height and cap height. And Amatic SC brings the quirk, its stroke ends as wide as the middle, like a rustic scrawl.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar reads clean and friendly, its curves leaving daylight like a rope's open bight above short ascender stems. But Amatic SC feels scribbled by hand, its y tail just as thick as its arm.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC bends its strokes like constant wire. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri has short ascenders, a tall x-height and an a with an open lower bowl, so let the sans-serif body run a touch larger.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Amatic SC draws a pen-like line of constant weight, rustic and quirky, with terminals that stop far from the stem. It's the playful one, while Noto Sans Syriac, with its blown-glass bowls, does the steady reading.
